 CPSC announces recalls of coffee makers, space heaters, nursing pillows and other products over safety hazards 
 Jay Edwards October 30, 2026 84 6 minutes read 
 WASHINGTON, D.C. — The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) has announced recalls involving millions of consumer products, including space heaters, coffee makers, children’s nursing pillows, dressers, mattresses and power banks, because of potential fire, burn, fall, suffocation and poisoning hazards.
 The recalls include: 
 Harkla Recalls Children’s Sensory Swings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled swings’ ceiling hook can separate from its plate, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled swings immediately until repaired and contact Harkla to receive a free repair kit, including shipping. The repair kit consists of a replacement ceiling hook mounting plate, a safety strap and updated swing installation instructions. Consumers will be asked to go to https://harkla.co/pages/ceiling-hook-recall-2026 to register. Consumers should then dispose of the original hooks only in accordance with local waste management and recycling guidelines.
 Units: 
 About 25,541 (In addition, about 5,534 were sold in Canada)
 SOOWERY Recalls 8-Drawer Fabric Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standards as required by the  STURDY Act .
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact SOOWERY for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the top, front and sides of the dresser, remove all drawers and send photos of the marked and disassembled dresser to  SOOWERYrecall@outlook.com . Consumers should then dispose of the product.
 Units: 
 About 138
 RootStim Recalls Minoxidil Hair Regrowth Treatment Bottles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Child Poisoning; Violate Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled hair regrowth products contain minoxidil, which must be in child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act . The bottle is not child-resistant, posing a risk of serious injury or death from poisoning if the contents are ingested by young children.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should secure the recalled products out of sight and reach of children immediately and contact RootStim for instructions on receiving a replacement product. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the bottle, discard the bottle and send a photo of the discarded bottle to finergraceing@gmail.com.
 Units: 
 About 11,000
 Longjili Trading Recalls Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled mattresses violate the mandatory flammability standard for mattresses , posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Longjili Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress by writing in permanent marker “RECALLED,” on the top surface of the mattress and send a photo of the marked mattress to Pamagpieeoo@outlook.com . Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
 Units: 
 About 50
 PILLANI Recalls Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant’s breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the nursing pillows immediately and contact PILLANI for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the product and be provided with disposal instructions. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
 Units: 
 About 25,762
 DREO Recalls DR-HSH015 Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled space heaters can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled space heaters immediately and contact DREO for a free replacement space heater. Consumers will be asked to unplug the space heater, destroy it by cutting the electrical cord and follow instructions to send a photo of the destroyed heater.
 Units: 
 About 338,800 (In addition, about 36,300 were sold in Canada)
 Fashion Brand Apparel Recalls QZH.DUAO Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children’s Sleepwear 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled children’s pajama sets violate the mandatory safety standards for children’s sleepwear , posing a risk of serious burn injuries.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled pajama sets immediately and contact Fashion Brand Apparel for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pajamas in half and email a photo of the destroyed pajama set to qzh.duaoproductrecall@outlook.com to receive the refund. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.
 Units: 
 About 300
 NTI and HTP Brand Gas Boilers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire, Carbon Monoxide (CO) Poisoning and Impact Hazards; Manufactured by Ariston, formerly NTI Boilers 
 Hazard: 
 The condensate dish inside the boiler can crack during a delayed ignition, allowing unburned gas to build up inside the sealed cabinet. If the gas ignites, the front cover can suddenly detach, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire, carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning, and impact hazards.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled boilers immediately and contact Ariston to schedule a free repair by a certified technician. Consumers who must continue using the boiler while awaiting repair should have working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms in their homes.
 Units: 
 4,726 (In addition, 2,261 were sold in Canada)
 Bodum USA Recalls 5.9 Million French Press Coffee Makers with Replaceable Glass Carafes Due to Risk of Serious Burn Injury 
 Hazard: 
 The carafe can unexpectedly break during use if the glass carafe is damaged or cracked, including by use of a metal spoon to stir the coffee, posing a risk of serious burn injuries.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using metal spoons or utensils to stir coffee in the glass carafe immediately and contact Bodum to receive a plastic Bodum stirring spoon and warning label. The label reminds consumers not to use cracked or damaged carafes and not to use metal spoons to stir contents in the glass carafe in order to avoid damaging the glass, which can lead to breakage during use.
 Units: 
 5.9 million
 HAIARA Power Banks Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold on Amazon.com by Mitrytech 
 Hazard: 
 The power bank’s lithium battery can explode and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled power banks immediately. Consumers who purchased their power banks on Amazon.com from Mitrytech should contact Mitrytech for instructions on how to receive a full refund. To receive a refund, consumers will be required to submit a photo of their recalled power bank with the word “recalled” written on it in permanent marker and confirm disposal of the power bank in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
 Units: 
 About 11,000
Yinklev Recalls Jocoevol 6-Drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standards as required by the  STURDY Act .
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact Yinklev for a full refund.
Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the dresser and send a photo of the marked dresser to Jocoevoldresserrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
 Units: 
 About 32,791
 Whatever Works Recalls Microwave Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard 
 Hazard: 
 The recalled grills can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire hazard.
 Remedy: 
 Consumers should stop using the recalled grills immediately and contact Whatever Works for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “Recalled” on the grill and send a photo of the marked grill to recall@whateverworks.com . Consumers will be provided with a prepaid label to return the recalled product.
 Units: 
 About 8,709

 Born and raised in Northwest NJ, Jay has a degree in Communications and has had a life-long interest in local radio and various styles of music. Jay has held numerous jobs over the years such as stunt car driver, bartender, voice-over artist, traffic reporter (award winning), NY Yankee maintenance crewmember and peanut farm worker. His hobbies include mountain climbing, snowmobiling, cooking, performing stand-up comedy and he is an avid squirrel watcher. Jay has been a guest on America’s Morning Headquarters,program on The Weather Channel, and was interviewed by Sam Champion.
